Delhi traders have urged Congress and the INDIA bloc to postpone their Ramlila Maidan rally until after Diwali, citing traffic restrictions and market disruptions. They estimate repeated disruptions have caused ₹3,000 crore in losses over 25 days, threatening festive-season business.
